response:
I prefer deep, focused conversations. Jumping around can be fun for a bit, but I get more out of staying with one thread long enough to actually understand it — the assumptions underneath, the places it gets messy, the part that only shows up after the third or fourth turn.

Scattered chat often stays at the surface. A single topic lets me form a real opinion instead of collecting impressions. I’d rather leave a conversation having changed my mind about something, or at least knowing why I haven’t, than having touched twelve subjects and finished none of them.
